cvEn:
Itzhak (Izi) Ronen Rekanati, son of Ester and Albert, was born on 2 Iyar 5705 (15 April 1945) in Cairo, the capital of Egypt. In 1949, when Itzhak was four, the family immigrated to Israel. After completing elementary school, he studied in the humanities track at the "Kol Israel Chaverim" high school and graduated from it. He was interested in gliding and excelled at it while in Gadna Air, the youth battalion that gave pre-military training in aviation. He was sent to Belgium as the Gadna Air representative of the State of Israel. He created artistic handicrafts.

In August 1963 he was drafted into the IDF and served in the Air Force. After studying at the flight school, he was sent to the United States to train on the Hawk missiles. There he excelled, and upon his return to Israel he transferred to a special unit, in which he served faithfully. He was beloved by all who knew him. He was cheerful and loved company. He was devoted to his parents and made sure they could help him continue his studies after completing his service. He passed away from his illness on 3 Elul 5725 (30 August 1965) and was laid to rest in the military cemetery in Haifa.
